card.name: Inside brand and drug names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a brand or generic drug name that is split into parts, such as XEL in XELJANZ, dapagl-if-lozin, PL-UV-ICTO. It also fires on digits inside numbers in dosing tables.

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or generic drug name or gene name, before the rest of the name follows.

modes.label: Digits in dose and lab numbers
modes.description: A digit or unit piece inside a number in a dosing or lab-threshold table.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name or number, before the name or number is finished.
